description: This PHP class defines a client for interacting with the Amazon Location Service Maps V2 API, providing methods to retrieve glyphs, sprites, static maps, style descriptors, and map tiles with asynchronous variants.

classes.name: GeoMapsClient
classes.description: A client class extending AwsClient, specialized for interacting with Amazon Location Service Maps V2.

methods.name: getGlyphsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves glyphs for the map.

methods.name: getSprites
methods.description: Retrieves sprite images for the map.

methods.name: getSpritesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves sprite images for the map.

methods.name: getStaticMapAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a static map image.

methods.name: getStyleDescriptor
methods.description: Retrieves the style descriptor for the map.

methods.name: getStyleDescriptorAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the style descriptor for the map.
